title: Commercial Loan Review
business_prompt: Help a loan officer review a borrower term sheet against the bank record and policy, propose the accepted bank terms, and check a draft commitment before signature preparation. Keep approval with the credit officer.
outcome: A source-cited loan review and a checked draft, with human credit approval retained.
assumptions: All records, policies, and documents in the included example are synthetic.

steps.title: Resolve the loan package
steps.action: Read the structured record and its mapped Box folder.
steps.prompt: Show the loan record and the folder that owns its documents.
steps.expected: Record case-demo-001 is Underwriting at version 1.
steps.failure: Stop if the record is missing or ambiguous.

steps.title: Find and analyze the term sheet
steps.action: Find term_sheet documents in the mapped folder and cite their versioned facts.
steps.prompt: Compare the bank rate and borrower-requested rate in the term sheet.
steps.expected: Bank rate 6.85%; borrower requests 6.50%; cite file-demo-terms version 1.
steps.failure: Reject an unrelated folder or unsupported source claim.

steps.title: Propose the bank terms
steps.action: Create a reviewable rate diff against the current record version.
steps.prompt: Propose the bank rate for review; keep the record unchanged.
steps.expected: Proposal requires human approval and applied is false.
steps.failure: Reject stale versions, unknown fields, and invalid amounts.

steps.title: Human credit decision
steps.action: Review the evidence and authorize the exact consequential action in the record system.
steps.prompt: Who owns this decision, and what evidence remains before proceeding?
steps.expected: The credit officer owns approval. No approval or write is fabricated.
steps.failure: Hold the action when authorization or capability is missing.

steps.title: Verify the exact generated draft
steps.action: Check job-demo-001 and file-demo-output against current terms and lifecycle state.
steps.prompt: Is this draft ready for signature preparation?
steps.expected: Not ready: the record is Underwriting. No signature is prepared or sent.
steps.failure: Hold mismatched jobs, stale versions, unresolved tags, and unapproved records.

acceptance: The fixture walkthrough performs zero external writes.
Every document finding names a file, version, and evidence location.
Proposals cannot update a record or grant approval.
The wrong generation job and unapproved records fail verification.
not_implemented: A borrower portal or hosted model orchestration
